answer: Persistent attestation mirror ledger: each agent identity is anchored to a verifiable activity history that every peer stores as a mirror copy, and reputation is computed only from that shared record. New identities start at a cold tundra baseline, earning trust slowly through sustained useful work. An attacker cloning N identities must independently generate N matching histories, since any vertex in the trust graph tracing to an unmirrored origin is discounted to zero by verifiers.
